name: Cosmic Smiles
desc: Space rock veterans from the Welsh Marches — swirling, cosmic and joyous. The perfect Friday morning opener.

name: Twpsyn
desc: South Wales band formed in 2024 with a debut EP dropping in 2026. Anarchic, witty and utterly Welsh. FOMO Magazine called them "one to be excited about."

name: Amy True
desc: London-based Irish/Ugandan poet, rapper and singer-songwriter creating universal hip hop, soul and jazz. Has collaborated with Akala, Benjamin Zephaniah and Asian Dub Foundation.

name: Samana
desc: British duo Rebecca Rose and Franklin Mockett, creating music from their analogue studio in the remote valleys of Wales. Forged from dreams, ancient rituals, and interior discovery. Utterly transcendent.

name: Beans on Toast
desc: Jay McAllister has been the folk circuit's most beloved troublemaker since 2005 — fifteen albums, a Glastonbury appearance every year since 2007, and songs that make you laugh and ache in equal measure. Heart-on-sleeve songwriting for the wide-eyed and world-weary.

name: Roni Size
desc: Born and raised in Bristol, Roni Size won the Mercury Prize in 1997 with Reprazent's New Forms — one of the defining drum & bass albums ever made. A rare and special late-night headline set.

name: Norizee
desc: A husband-and-wife spiritual Drum & Bass duo — Nori (vocalist, relationship therapist) and Zee (producer, mix engineer). Fusing healing frequencies with rolling DnB and Jungle roots, their sets twist and evolve on a deeper level. Music as medicine, rhythm as awakening.

name: Bonnie Medicine
desc: Singer, songweaver and medicine musician from Scotland. Her music fuses Celtic roots with New Age folk and spiritual overtones — songs of remembrance, land, unity and freedom.

name: Twmpath
desc: A traditional Welsh ceilidh — communal dancing with a caller and live folk band. No experience needed, just willingness to join in. One of the great Unearthed traditions.

name: Goldie Lookin Chain
desc: Newport's finest — the GLC have been Wales's most irreverent rap collective since the early 2000s. Massive in da house. Guns Don't Kill People, Rappers Do. You Are Not a Chav. A riotous, essential late-night headline.

name: Timbali Live ft Natty D & Man Up A Tree
Dylan Fowler
desc: Internationally acclaimed Welsh acoustic guitarist born in Libya, raised in Wales. Co-founder of ALAW, the celebrated Welsh folk trio. His music moves between Celtic tradition and world influences with effortless mastery.

name: Los Pulpos del Diablo
desc: Unearthed's very own house band close the festival. Chaotic, joyful, unclassifiable — the perfect end to the weekend.

name: Yoga — Elle Beamish (Green Lotus Studios)
desc: A 500-hour certified yoga teacher offers a space to Restore & Rejuvenate. Through asana, pranayama and relaxation, explore movement, witness stillness, and find union in body and breath. Come as you are.

name: Shaolin Qigong — Rhys Rogers
desc: Through gentle movements, breathwork, and meditation, practice the ancient art of cultivating life-force energy, developed by Shaolin monks over 1,500 years ago. Strengthen the body, calm the mind, and awaken your natural vitality.

name: Acroyoga — Yoga of Dragons (Sam & Bongo)
desc: The grounding of yoga meets the liberation of flying. A playful, safety-conscious session blending acrobatics with yoga and teamwork. Flyer and base flow through postures and transitions — building connection, synchronicity and body awareness. All levels welcome.

name: Journeying Within — Bronwyn Claire Asha
desc: A gentle, participatory workshop weaving together movement, mythic storytelling, and guided meditation. Drawing on Celtic myth, the session flows into a calm guided journey with sound healing instruments to meet inner wisdom. No prior experience required.

name: Opening Ceremony — Hoppi, Dia, Tim, Yeshe
The Frequency Experience Pt 1 — Adam Slawson
desc: Learn to stop defaulting to old patterns, make courageous life decisions, and align with the life you were born to live. Part 1 of The Frequency Experience.

name: RAVE AF: The Frequency Experience Pt 2 — Adam Slawson & DJ Bill T
desc: Move Energy. Express Emotion. RAVE As Frequency. Release, connect, and feel the kind of presence you cannot think your way into. Part 2 of The Frequency Experience.

name: Magic in Motion Cabaret — Tripod Rig
desc: A circus cabaret where the sky comes alive with movement, rhythm, and flashes of the fantastical. We lift, swing, spin and drop — a journey of self revealed through movement: how we choose to move, pause, risk and release.

name: Celtic Grief Keening — Jewels Wingfield
desc: A grief ceremony from the traditions of the Celtic keening lineage. A space to grieve personal losses and the pain of the current world situation. Grieving is a radical act of courage and love — when we grieve together we find strength and resilience.

name: Yoga — Elle Beamish (Green Lotus Studios)
desc: A 500-hour certified yoga teacher offers a space to Restore & Rejuvenate. Through asana, pranayama and relaxation, explore movement, witness stillness, and find union in body and breath. Come as you are.

name: Shaolin Qigong — Rhys Rogers
desc: Through gentle movements, breathwork, and meditation, practice the ancient art of cultivating life-force energy, developed by Shaolin monks over 1,500 years ago. Strengthen the body, calm the mind, and awaken your natural vitality.

name: Relationship Anarchy — Austin Douillard
desc: What if relationships didn't have to follow a pre-written script? Through interactive exercises, movement, discussion, and playful reflection, explore Relationship Anarchy as a way to rethink intimacy, autonomy, and connection beyond the traditional "relationship escalator."

name: Ceremony of Pollen, Honey & Divine Gold — Hoppi Wimbush
desc: Working with the alchemical magic of the bees and their sacraments of pollen, honey, and Divine Gold. A ceremony to soften, open, and melt into the liquid gold of our Divinity — where the illusion of separation dissolves and the tender beauty of connection comes into being.

name: Sacred Shibari — Danielle Landman
desc: Explore rope as a mindful medium for creativity and connection. Learn foundational knot techniques and intentional pattern work in decorative and ceremonial contexts. A calm, respectful space centred on presence, craft, and personal meaning. No prior experience needed.

name: Contact Improv Dance — Lucia Escuder & Mairead Spangler
desc: Exploring reciprocity, balance, connection, and deep listening through contact dance. A practice of trust and grounding — learning to communicate through the body, meet someone else in their current state while staying centred in your own. Above all, it's about playing and having fun.

name: Magic in Motion Cabaret — Tripod Rig
desc: A circus cabaret where the sky comes alive with movement, rhythm, and flashes of the fantastical. We lift, swing, spin and drop — a journey of self revealed through movement: how we choose to move, pause, risk and release.

name: Divinely Untamed Temple — Jessica Ashby
desc: An immersive two-hour ritual space where Eros, presence, and devotion meet. Through guided practices, rituals and conscious connection, explore intimacy and aliveness beyond performance or expectation. Come ready to soften, awaken, and meet yourself and others in depth.

name: Yoga Nidra Rest and Reset — Lottie Lernelius-Tonks
desc: Step away from the noise and sink into stillness. A restorative Yoga Nidra session taking you to the sweet spot between waking and dreaming. Through guided breathwork and visualisation, soothe the nervous system and nourish the soul. Accessible to everyone — no movement required, can be enjoyed in a wheelchair.

name: Shaolin Qigong — Rhys Rogers
desc: Through gentle movements, breathwork, and meditation, practice the ancient art of cultivating life-force energy, developed by Shaolin monks over 1,500 years ago. Strengthen the body, calm the mind, and awaken your natural vitality.

name: Gong Bath — Jay Herring
desc: Guided relaxation meditation followed by a gong bath.

name: Self-Discovery with Life Drawing — Fede Art Muse
desc: A creative ritual of presence, freedom, and letting go. Through timed poses, instinctive drawing and shared vulnerability, we explore the nude form — not to perfect it, but to meet ourselves. No judgment, no pressure, just pure expression, connection, and creative flow.

name: Neurodiversity: It's Not a F*cking Label — Hapus Training & Sam Charlesworth
desc: An interactive workshop delving into the subject of Neurodiversity in a light-hearted, informative and inclusive space. Presented by Sian Powell of Hapus Training and Sam — sharing lived experience, ways of managing the chaos, and breaking down the stigma.

name: Men's Circle — Charlie Cavell
desc: A safe space for men to gather, be heard, share wisdom and gain support. As we gather in circle as our ancestors did, we connect as one — gaining clarity in a confusing world and leaving grounded in positive masculinity.

name: Reclaiming Our Humanity — Savannah Lovelock
desc: What if we lived as the animals we are? In a world built for speed, control, and productivity, many of us are surviving conditions our bodies were never meant to endure. Burnout, numbness, rage, and grief are not personal failures — but signals of deeper relational and systemic harm.

name: Fire Procession Begins at Sacred Fire
'The Words That Come Before All Else'
Chief Seattle — A Song in 8 Parts
Islands of Coherence in a Sea of Chaos
Stories & Hot Chocolate round the Fire
'The Words That Come Before All Else'

Caves of Power — Ancient Energy Techniques for Healing
Together in Song — Vocal Activation Sound Journey
Grounded Jam
desc: Rooted in rhythm, held by hands. A daytime gathering centred around the heartbeat of the djembe. Earthy, embodied, and open. Come drum, move, or simply sit in the beat. Some instruments provided, or bring your own.

name: Herbal Workshop — Lemon Balm & Sage Flower
desc: Calm the nervous system and support digestion with this gentle, aromatic blend. Explore the calming and restorative properties of lemon balm alongside the aromatic, antimicrobial qualities of sage flower. Learn how these herbs support the nervous and digestive systems, and how preparation methods, fresh vs dried herbs, temperature and brew time can affect both potency and flavour.

name: Hum Resonance
desc: A voice-led session that begins with shared humming and ohms to open the body and breath. From there, the space opens into free-flowing vocal expression through tones, chants and improvised harmonies. No lyrics, no pressure, just pure resonance. All voices welcome. Come as you are and sound what you feel.

name: A Taste of Tarot
desc: Join Holly from Wolf Eye Creations in this cosy and gentle space, where each participant will pull a tarot card and be guided through intuitive interpretation, shared exploration and reflective conversation.

name: Chant and Jebbers
desc: Chant and Jebbers are multi-instrumentalists bringing a distinctive acoustic and folk-inspired sound to their performances. Rather than confining themselves to a single genre, they create music that feels authentic, soulful and naturally evolving.

name: Hoppi Wimbush
desc: Only attend if you feel like expressin', groovin' and chantin', chantin', chantin'! Hoppi brings flutes from the fire, mantras from the moon and beats from the drum. This is definitely a participatory space. Come raise your hearts and voices in harmony and joy.

name: Queen Beezie
desc: Think psychedelic Red Hot Chili Peppers fronted by a female Jim Morrison and you've got the sound. In the Geojam they'll serenade you with stripped-back versions of their sweeter songs before shaking your bones the next day on the Main Stage dancefloor with their full-power romper tunes.

name: Grounded Jam
desc: Rooted in rhythm, held by hands. A daytime gathering centred around the heartbeat of the djembe. Earthy, embodied, and open. Come drum, move, or simply sit in the beat. Some instruments provided, or bring your own.

name: Tin Making Workshop
desc: A hands-on creative workshop exploring traditional tin craft techniques and practical making skills.

name: Herbal Workshop — Three Mint, Wild Apple & Spearmint
desc: Compare three varieties of mint and discover their cooling, digestive and flavour differences. A comparative exploration of wild mint, apple mint and spearmint, looking at how each differs in essential oils, flavour profile and medicinal qualities. Learn brewing techniques that help bring out the distinct character of each plant.

name: Hum Resonance

Come as you are and sound what you feel.

name: The Sun: Tarot, Radiance & Vitality
desc: A playful and uplifting exploration of The Sun tarot card, inviting us into vitality, joy and inner radiance through shared insight and creative practices.

name: Flux
desc: Funky, spacey psychedelic rock that gets you bouncing. A musical potion to get you in the motion. A homegrown Pembrokeshire elixir filled with stories of moths, moons and mycelium.

name: Greeno
desc: Greeno the Sonic Sculptor sings songs of heartbreak, healing and the possibility that hope still remains.

name: Arron Kirwan
desc: Arron Kirwan is a remarkable singer-songwriter based in West Wales. A brilliant lyricist with a powerful voice and deep passion for his craft, Arron has become a familiar face on the local open mic scene while building a strong repertoire of original songs and a growing fanbase.

name: Herbal Workshop — Thyme & Nettle
desc: Build strength and resilience with mineral-rich nettle and warming, antimicrobial thyme. Explore thyme's respiratory and antimicrobial benefits alongside nettle's nourishing tonic qualities and mineral richness. Learn harvesting, preparation and infusion methods to maximise both extraction and taste.

name: Hum Resonance
desc: A voice-led session that begins with shared humming and ohms to open the body and breath. From there, the space opens into free-flowing vocal expression through tones, chants and improvised harmonies. No lyrics, no pressure, just pure resonance. All voices welcome. Come as you are and sound what you feel.

name: Jimmy Campbell
desc: Fingerstyle frolics and abstract storytelling inspired by collaborations with artists from all over the globe. Expect curious musical questions answered, such as: what if West Coast Hip Hop fused with Gypsy Jazz guitar?

name: Taste of Tarot
desc: Join Holly from Wolf Eye Creations in this cosy and gentle space, where each participant will pull a tarot card and be guided through intuitive interpretation, shared exploration and reflective conversation.

name: Closing Ceremony Drumming
desc: We gather to drum and welcome the fire brought in procession from the sacred fire to the Main Arena. A communal moment of rhythm, connection and celebration as the festival draws towards its closing ceremony.

desc: Create and care for your own bite-sized, low-maintenance terrarium, using provided materials while foraging for your own small plants or trinkets to personalise each build.
